1.consolidated_definition: Guineo manzano maduro, que al quitarle la cáscara presenta unos pedazos algo más duros y de color morado.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Mature guineo manzano banana, presenting pieces that are slightly harder and of a deep purple color when the skin is removed.
